findings.issue: Rating validation condition uses && instead of ||, so the range check is always false and never rejects out-of-range ratings.
findings.evidence: if (!Number.isInteger(rating) || (rating < 1 && rating > 5)) { — no integer is simultaneously <1 and >5, so a rating of 0, -5, or 999 bypasses the 400 response and is persisted via Review.updateReview.

findings.issue: Pagination offset computed as page*pageSize instead of (page-1)*pageSize, skipping a page of results.
findings.evidence: [pageSize, page * pageSize] with the doc comment 'page starts at 1'; page=1, pageSize=10 yields OFFSET 10, so the first 10 rows are never returned.

findings.issue: getReviewsSorted interpolates the caller-supplied sort string directly into the SQL ORDER BY clause with no whitelist/validation, allowing SQL injection.
findings.evidence: ORDER BY ${sort}, fed from src/routes/api.ts:36 const sort = (req.query.sort as string) || 'r.created_at DESC'; unlike getBooksPage which whitelists via BOOK_SORT_COLUMNS.

findings.issue: User-controlled display_name interpolated into raw HTML response without escaping, enabling stored XSS.
findings.evidence: ${top.display_name} rated it ${top.rating}/5 in the /books/:id/top-review endpoint; rendered via res.send() with no escaping.
